title: Battle of Chausa
detail: At Chausa on 26 June 1539, Sher Shah defeated Humayun in a decisive battle. The defeat weakened early Mughal momentum and elevated Afghan power in the eastern subcontinent, with direct consequences for Bengal's political trajectory.

title: Historical consequence
detail: The Chausa defeat prolonged Afghan leverage in the east and postponed a durable Mughal settlement in Bengal.
